svg.title: Error when the full outer measurement is forced only every T rounds

cc:Work.dc:title: Error when the full outer measurement is forced only every T rounds
cc:Work.dc:description: Four stacked panels, rules B, C, R and P: logical error relative to full extraction every round, at each p, with 95% intervals. Rule B stays at about 1 for T = 2, 4, 8 and never; rule P sits at 0.64 to 0.82 up to T = 8 and 1.0 to 1.2 at T = 16; rules C and R are 1.1 to 1.5.
